summary: M0 model-only verdict: BENIGN @ 1.00. The account shows a long-established, consistent legitimate pattern: daily sign-ins from 198.51.100.77 (AS16135 Turkcell, Istanbul, TR) on device DEV-H07-P alternating between lms and mail, each with exactly one MFA prompt and an approved result. The numerous sign-in failures from cloud providers (Contabo, OVH, Linode, Datacamp, M247, Hetzner) across Nuremberg/Frankfurt/Gravelines/Newark/Bucharest/Helsinki all returned "failure" with mfa_prompt_count 0, meaning they never reached/satisfied MFA and did not authenticate. There is no successful sign-in from an anomalous location/device, no MFA bypass, and no evidence the actor gained access. The suspicious signal is therefore explained as unsuccessful password-spray/brute-force noise against an MFA-protected account that remains under the legitimate user's control. No account takeover is confirmed.
